column7: I chose to link SC subgenres to deep house when they are house and edm when they are EDM.
e.g: the SC turkish deep house subgenre is linked to edm and not deep house as it falls into the second category.
- There is a minimal synth subgenre within the dance genre.
Minimal synth is a musical movement that goes hand in hand with space synth, synth wave, dark synth, cyberpunk, etc.
One could call this musical genre synthwave.
Without requiring to create a genre (because Shotgun probably made this choice due to the lack of relevant events),
the fact of only including minimal synth is not, in my opinion, the most relevant choice.
We could imagine putting synthwave instead, which would have the advantage of being able to associate all the trends of the genre.
The space synth, synth wave, dark synth, cyberpunk events/artists would thus be grouped together (and not Null as they are now).
- When a subgenre exists in Souncharts but not in Shotgun, I've linked it to Null even if a parent genre could have corresponded.
ex : cuban alternative exists in SC, but not in Shotgun. I've thus linked it to Null thought it is related to the parent genre latin / brazilian

I would suggest that, for each genre, a sub-genre of the same name should exist (as is already the case for the afro, dance, experimental, hip hop, house, metel, pop, reggae dub, rock, techno, industrial genres, trance).
NB1 : Reggae / dub does not require a subgenre named Reggae / dub because the subgenres already cover enought.
NB2 : the hard music genre already has the hardcore subgenre to link every subgenre that cannot be linked to another one.
My suggestion is therefore to create the Latin/Brazilian, UK and instrumental subgenres.
Thus the SC cuban alternative, deep latin alternative, tropical alternativo etc. subgenres could be linked to the Latin/Brazilian Shotgun genre
- When a subgenre exists in Soundcharts but not in Shotgun but a Shotgun subgenre seems close enough, I link it to that one.

column7: ex: SC dance-punk is not exactly indie rock but close enough so that fans of this genre find it normal that their favorite dance-punk band finds itself labeled indie rock.
They will find it more relevant than just rock.
- We often see regional designations of a genre. e.g: australian house, french house, greek house
-> Some of them are commercial subgenres, meaning that they just aim at grouping artists from a same regional space
but not necessarly sharing musical caracteristics
e.g greek house covers a lot of different genres (eurohouse, bass house, melodic house)
-> Some really are relevant subgenres with their own identity
e.g french house, UK house are specific subgenres of house
-> Some have their own identity without having anything to do with the designated genre
e.g dutch house which is far from being house
Thus each one of those has been linked to the most relevant Shotgun subgenre.
- Afrobeat (nigerian jazz) is defferent from afrobeats (afro pop)
Thus the afrobeats subgenres are linked to afro and not afrobeat.
